description: By Joanne Muto | English Teacher, Pilgrim High School & Wife & Campaign PartnerYou may recognize Bill Muto from campaign signs, council meetings, or his work on city finances. You see the polished graphics and the spreadsheets. I see something different. I see him at our kitchen table at 11:30 on a Sunday night after I have already headed to bed, surrounded by municipal reports, color‑coded notes, and a cooling mug of coffee.My name is Joanne Muto.
